{{Quote|What we ''want'' to do is play on their mutual suspicions&mdash;break up the negotiations and make it seem like ''their'' idea.|Morrigan Corde, to Jor Torlin|<ref name="Legacy 10" />}}
A '''skirmish''' took place both aboard and in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] outside of [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[137 ABY]]. Although fought between members of the [[Empire-in-exile]] and [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], it was engineered by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the [[One Sith]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], whose machinations served to disrupt a potential [[Alliance (Second Imperial Civil War)|alliance]] between Empire-in-exile and Remnant forces. The skirmish came about due to a meeting aboard the station between Remnant [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] and Empire-in-exile [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mingo Bovark]], who were discussing the idea of combining their organizations' strength against [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] in the ongoing [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&ndash;Imperial agents [[Jor Torlin]] and [[Morrigan Corde]] were concurrently on the station, [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] for the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cade Skywalker]], whom Krayt sought.

After determining that Skywalker was no longer aboard, Torlin and Corde decided to disrupt the negotiations through [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]]. Using [[Command Override Limpet Droid]]s, Torlin remotely [[Slicer/Legends|took control]] of a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] aboard Bovark's [[Unidentified Nune-class Imperial shuttle|shuttle]] and [[Laser/Legends|fired]] at the nearby Remnant [[Unidentified Crix-class diplomatic courier shuttle|shuttle]]. When news reached Stazi, he attacked Bovark with a [[Vibro-shiv/Legends|vibro-shiv]], while a [[lightfight]] erupted outside of their conference room between Stazi's [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence officer|bodyguards]] and Bovark's [[Imperial Knight]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|protectors]], [[Antares Draco]] and [[Ganner Krieg]]. Draco was able to rescue Bovark, but the Imperials' escape was blocked by Wheel [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Pol Temm]] and the [[Wheel Security Force]]. Temm barred all of Fel's forces from the station, and the Empire-in-exile remained devoid of allies.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I must assume at this point that the Sith tracked you back here&mdash;which means Krayt probably knows I've taken Bastion. He knows an all-out attack on Bastion would decimate his forces and cripple his ability to command the galaxy. ''I'' can no longer be sure I can bring in new troops. We have a ''stalemate''. Thanks, in large part, to you two.|Emperor Roan Fel, to Antares Draco and Ganner Krieg|<ref name="Legacy 9" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[137 ABY]], [[Darth Maladi]] of the [[One Sith]] assigned her [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jor Torlin]] to find [[Cade Skywalker]],<ref name="Legacy 9">[[Legacy (2006) 9|''Legacy'' (2006) 9]]</ref> a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] whose [[Dark transfer|healing powers]] were sought by Maladi's [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="Legacy 7" /> Torlin tracked Skywalker to [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Besh Gorgon system/Legends|Besh Gorgon system]], as did [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. Hoping to gain leverage over her [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] superiors, Calixte went to The Wheel disguised as her secret alter-ego, Imperial Agent Morrigan Corde.<ref name="Legacy 9" /><ref name="Legacy 19">[[Legacy (2006) 19|''Legacy'' (2006) 19]]</ref>

The year 137 ABY also saw [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] [[Fall of Bastion|retake]] the [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] from Krayt's [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]]. Fel had been making guerrilla strikes against Krayt's Empire for seven years in the ongoing [[Second Imperial Civil War]], and he hoped to keep his capture of Bastion&mdash;which he believed would render him a more potent threat&mdash;a secret while he drew more strength to it.<ref name="Legacy 3">[[Legacy (2006) 3|''Legacy'' (2006) 3]]</ref> The news reached Krayt through members of the Sith&ndash;Imperial&ndash;loyal [[Imperial Mission]],<ref name="Legacy 7" /> but Fel placed the blame on two of his [[Imperial Knight]]s, [[Antares Draco]] and [[Ganner Krieg]]. The two had departed Bastion to [[Skirmish on Vendaxa|rescue]] Fel's [[Gender/Legends|daughter]], [[Marasiah Fel|Marasiah]], from the clutches of the Sith, and Fel assumed that they had been tracked back to the fortress [[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="Legacy 9" />

Believing that he now had a stalemate against Krayt's Empire, Fel sent [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mingo Bovark]] to propose an alliance to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]&mdash;which also opposed Krayt's Empire&mdash;aboard The Wheel, which was well-known for its neutrality. Draco's and Krieg's punishment was to act as Bovark's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. The Knights and Stazi's three [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence officer]]s all contravened Wheel policy by smuggling weapons aboard, and both sets of guards waited outside of a conference room, where Bovark and Stazi negotiated. Elsewhere on The Wheel, Corde established contact with Torlin,<ref name="Legacy 9" /> and the two determined that Skywalker had already left the station. Corde had additionally learned of the meeting between Bovark and Stazi, and she suggested that they disrupt it before pursing their target any further.<ref name="Legacy 10" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|What is it, Admiral? What's happening?''"<br />"''Imperial treachery! This time you will pay a price!|Mingo Bovark and Gar Stazi|<ref name="Legacy 10" />}}
[[File:Sabotageonthewheel.jpg|thumb|left|175px|The Galactic Alliance Remnant's shuttle comes under attack.]]
While planning aboard his personal [[Gladius-class light freighter|ship]], the [[Raider (Gladius-class)|''Raider'']], Torlin proposed calling in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], but his counterpart was insistent that they play on Bovark's and Stazi's mutual suspicions of each other rather than presenting a common enemy. Torlin accordingly produced six [[Command Override Limpet Droid]]s, devices that could adhere to the [[Hull/Legends|exterior]] of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and [[Slicer/Legends|override]] its onboard [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. The Empire-in-exile's [[Unidentified Nune-class Imperial shuttle|''Nune''-class Imperial shuttle]] was docked close to the Galactic Alliance Remnant's [[Unidentified Crix-class diplomatic courier shuttle|''Crix''-class diplomatic courier shuttle]], and Torlin remotely directed the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] through [[Realspace/Legends|space]] before attaching them to the [[Nune-class Imperial shuttle|Imperial ship]], where they took control of a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] battery. The Imperials aboard were unable to override, and Torlin blasted the [[Crix-class diplomatic courier shuttle|Remnant shuttle]], whose crew raised their [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and returned [[Laser/Legends|fire]]. The Imperials' own shields went up as the two [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] continued their salvos, and Stazi was informed of the situation via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="Legacy 10" />

In the conference room, Stazi drew a [[Vibro-shiv/Legends|vibro-shiv]] from his [[Clothing/Legends|robes]]. Although the Captain frantically tried to convince the Admiral that a misunderstanding had occurred, Stazi's distrust of Imperials caused him to strike and draw [[Blood/Legends|blood]] from a slash at Bovark's side. The Alliance [[Officer/Legends|officers]] meanwhile initiated a [[lightfight]] in the hallway, and the Imperial Knights used their [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|lightsabers]] to deflect their attackers' [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts. Krieg took up the defense single-handedly as Draco cut his way through the conference room door and [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] shoved Stazi into a wall with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] before retrieving the injured Bovark. Bovark's wound was only skin-deep, but the Imperials' escape was halted by Wheel [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Pol Temm]] and four members of the [[Wheel Security Force]]. Temm demanded that the Imperial Knights surrender their [[Lightsaber/Legends|weapons]], but Draco refused, adamant that the Captain be safely returned to his shuttle. The Administrator consequently barred all of Fel's forces from the station; Draco suspected [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] and vowed to find whomever was responsible.<ref name="Legacy 10" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I think our work here is done&mdash;now to find ''Cade Skywalker''.|Morrigan Corde|<ref name="Legacy 10" />}}
After Torlin's droids detached themselves from the Imperial shuttle, their circuits fused and they became space junk. He and Corde then departed The Wheel to search for Skywalker on the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], location of the former [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]]. Once on the [[Tree/Legends|jungle]] world's surface, Torlin [[Mission to Ossus (137 ABY)|attacked]] Corde out of mistrust and a conviction that he would be safer if she were [[Death/Legends|dead]]. Only Corde survived the encounter.<ref name="Legacy 10" /> Later in the year, when Skywalker was [[Duel in the Temple of the Sith|captured]] by the Sith, Nyna Calixte pointed to "Morrigan Corde's" success in sabotaging the negotiations aboard The Wheel when convincing her co-conspirator, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Morlish Veed]], that Corde should be the one to [[Skirmish at the Temple of the Sith|retrieve]] Skywalker from Krayt's clutches and give them the leverage they needed in their scheming against the Sith.<ref name="Legacy 15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref> Admiral Stazi remained distrustful of the Empire-in-exile until the Imperial Knights [[Treis Sinde]] and [[Sigel Dare]] risked their lives to [[Massacre of New Coral City|rescue]] Alliance [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by the Sith&ndash;Imperials on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], and to personally warn him of explosives that they had planted on the Sith&ndash;Imperial [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']] prior to his capture of it during a [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|battle]] over the [[Water/Legends|water]] world. Only then did the Admiral decide to resume negotiating an alliance with Fel against a common foe.<ref name="Legacy 22">[[Legacy (2006) 22|''Legacy'' (2006) 22]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gatoughs.jpg|thumb|right|100px|The Alliance bodyguards from the skirmish were later identified as Galactic Alliance Intelligence officers.]]
{{Quote|No more negotiations!|A description of the skirmish from the cover of ''Star Wars: Legacy 10''|<ref name="Legacy 10" />}}
The skirmish on The Wheel occurs in the [[Legacy (2006) 10|tenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Colin Wilson (artist)|Colin Wilson]], and released in [[March]] [[2007]]. The issue's cover art, done by [[Dave Ross]], depicts the skirmish differently than what occurs within the comic's pages. In ''Legacy 10'', Antares Draco and Ganner Krieg battle Alliance bodyguards<ref name="Legacy 10" /> whose uniforms were later attributed to [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service|Galactic Alliance Intelligence]] officers in [[2009]]'s ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'',<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> whereas the cover art puts two of the guards in [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="Legacy 10" /> similar to that worn by [[Galactic Alliance Infantry Trooper]]s in the ''Campaign Guide''.<ref name="LECG" /> The cover art also depicts the lightfight between the Alliance guards and Imperial Knights as spilling into the conference room, where Draco Force-pushes one of the guards out of Bovark's way. However, the issue has just Draco entering the conference room and Force-pushing Gar Stazi while Krieg and all three Alliance guards remain in the hallway.<ref name="Legacy 10" />
